note: A-9: the bridge-tender houses, dressed on their OpenStreetMap footprints (lib/bridgehouses.js). Each house takes its bridge's style (bridges.json houses.style). Near the river its stone base runs down to the water (levels.json RIVER_Y − 0.5), as the real houses stand on the bascule piers. Heights are above the street (model y 0); the forms are read from photographs and are approximate unless a source says more.
sources: https://www.chicagoloopbridges.com/ (the bridge-tender houses, bridge by bridge)
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DuSable_Bridge (Bedford-stone bridgehouses; the four reliefs and their corners; the McCormick Bridgehouse & Chicago River Museum, 5 floors)
OpenStreetMap (ODbL): the bridgehouse footprints (building=service, name '… Bridgehouse' / 'Bridge House')

beaux-arts.about: 1910s–1920s City Beautiful houses: Bedford limestone, rusticated base, arched windows, a cornice and a verdigris copper hip roof (Franklin, Wells, Lake, Washington, Madison, Jackson). Read from photographs

deco.about: 1929–30 Art Deco houses: stepped massing, fluted piers between tall window strips, a stepped parapet (Clark Street). Read from photographs

moderne.about: 1937–1956 Streamline Moderne houses: rounded corners, a ribbon of windows, a thin overhanging roof slab (State Street, the Outer Drive, Van Buren, Congress). Read from photographs

modern.about: 1960–1984 glass-and-steel cabins: a glazed box in a dark steel frame under a flat roof slab (Dearborn, Columbus, Randolph). Read from photographs

dusable.about: Edward H. Bennett's four Bedford-stone bridgehouses (1920): towers rising from the river, rusticated below the street, corner pilasters, a cornice and attic; the 1928 reliefs high on their outward faces. The museum (SW house) has five floors from the Riverwalk. Heights read from photographs (approximate)

dusable.reliefNote: Wikipedia (DuSable Bridge): The Discoverers is on the northwest house and The Pioneers on the northeast (Fraser); Defense southwest and Regeneration southeast (Hering). bridges.json's older reliefs map has ne/nw swapped; this file is the source of truth.
